description: Smoke sweep for the photonic ZINC encoding on its remote machine: seed 0, 2 epochs, one worker. Downloads the ZINC subset in a single process before the parallel sweep, and checks the MerLin cross-check, GPU placement, parameter count and the first-epoch feature precompute time.
checkpoint_rule: model with the lowest validation MAE over the 2 epochs
aggregation: single seed; smoke only, not a result
